description: The main window, and nothing else. Every permission below is justified in one line, per plan.md M4's capability audit. Note what is NOT here: no filesystem scope, and no opener scope — opening a file or a folder is a Rust command that takes no path (see main.rs), so the webview cannot name one. `core:window:allow-start-dragging` moves the window when the title strip is dragged — it is not in `core:default`, and without it the strip is inert (D-088); it can move this window and do nothing else.
